question: How is the goddess Ucchiṣṭacaṇḍālinī identified and renowned at the conclusion of this passage?
premises: She is renowned in the three worlds.
inference: Therefore, this concludes the teaching of the goddess Ucchiṣṭacaṇḍālinī, renowned in the three worlds.
plain_english: Thus ends the teaching of the goddess Ucchiṣṭacaṇḍālinī, renowned in the three worlds.
